ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio of approximately 0.25:0.75 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) regions dominate the upper 80% of both lobes; high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and mottled grey regions are mapped primarily to the lower-inner quadrants flanking the median notch and the extreme trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 42 degrees and a depth approximately 1/4 of the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude varying between 4 and 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curves originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two dense, high-contrast white pixel clusters consisting of roughly circular geometric forms (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible; notably two parallel horizontal marks on the mid-left lobe and several intersecting diagonal marks on the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the fluke tips and visible tooth-rake scars across the ventral pigmentation.
